cost_definition: walk cost(w) = (fp_muls - verify_fp_muls) + w * 97 * (cmp + neg + modn + hash + table) from walk.ops, w = 0, 0.1, 1; pooled = sum over the eight curves of mean cost / sqrt(n); ratio = first arm / second arm; standard errors by the delta method over the per-curve means (independent arms; the seed-paired covariance version is given alongside); resolved = 95% interval excludes 1 at all three weights and |ratio - 1| exceeds |O24/O24AA - 1| at each weight (registered rule, §9.52)

checks.check: record layout: eight curves in E18's order; main stream seeds 48000+k (k < 128 schoolbook, k < 32 Karatsuba) x O6B, O6C, O24, O24L, O24F seed-major; A/A stream 49000+k (k < 128) x O24AA; karatsuba flag as named
curves: canonical b0 = 3, 3, 3, 9, 9, 2, 17, 3 as registered; n prime (deterministic Miller-Rabin, own code) and n = 1 mod 24 on every curve; n and b0 equal across the three runs

arms as registered: O6B = Order6Built, O6C = Order6Cheap, O24/O24AA = Order24Cheap, O24L = Order24CheapMulLean (jumps E34, r = 32); O24F = Order24Cheap with PairSums (r = 64); control = PairSumsBroken (r = 64); fold Psi (class size 6) on order 6, Twist24 (24) on order 24

G2.217 correctness: every walk of the three runs reports correct = true and recovers the same logarithm on its curve, equal to E34's recorded logarithm there; each ran the [d]G = Q check (verify counters > 0)
G2.218 positive control F-slash (b of each pair jump = b_j): wrong logarithm flagged on >= 31/32 walks at p = 241 and 541, seeds 48000-48015
checks.detail: 32/32; p=241: 16 walks seeds 48000-48015 true, flagged 16 , recovered != planted on 16; p=541: 16 walks seeds 48000-48015 true, flagged 16 , recovered != planted on 16

checks.check: instrument identities on every walk: classes = (n - 1)/m; stored + fruitless + 1 = steps (correct walks); fruitless = cycle escapes = sum of the length histogram; table = 2 steps - escapes - 1 and hash = 2 (steps - escapes - 1) (E34's counter identity); every cmp and neg is the representative's, which emits no hash or table operation
ideal sqrt(pi (n - 1)/(2m)) recomputed here from n and m equals the recorded ideal_steps on every walk
G2.221 F's added work: every O24F (and control) walk adds exactly 32 group additions and 64 mod-n operations, charged (added F_p multiplications are inside fp_muls); every E34-jump walk adds nothing
checks.detail: PairSums karatsuba=false: 1024 walks, added F_p multiplications 3104..3104 (97.000 per addition); PairSums karatsuba=true: 256 walks, added F_p multiplications 2528..2528 (79.000 per addition); PairSumsBroken karatsuba=false: 32 walks, added F_p multiplications 3104..3104 (97.000 per addition)

checks.check: set-up multiplications (cheap representative tables) charged on the cheap arms only
same walk on the paired arms: O6C equals O6B and O24L equals O24 per seed (steps, escapes, visit digest, logarithm), both arithmetics

Karatsuba walks equal the schoolbook walks of the same seed (steps, visit digest, group operations, every native counter, representative calls and multiplications); only the field arithmetic's F_p multiplications differ
